calculation_handling.description: Amending instruction (By-law 1075-2026, item 29): deletes regulation 10.5.60.30(2) from Zoning By-law 569-2013.
calculation_handling.gaps: Keyed PROCEDURAL (an amendment instruction). Its effect is that 10.5.60.30(2) no longer exists; it is not keyed DISAPPLY because it removes the regulation from the by-law rather than saying it does not apply in some case. The item number 29 is an enacting-by-law section number, not a literal. The content of the deleted regulation is not in this unit.

10.5.60.30(2)@1075-2026.explanation: By-law 1075-2026 deletes regulation 10.5.60.30(2) of the Zoning By-law, so that rule no longer applies.
